A submission returns the queue receipt, or null when no
editor is selected. Dispose detaches integrations before closing the workspace.

Render functions are
output sinks and do not call application code.
An outlet acquires the visit active when binding is called; it cannot infer an earlier action from a receipt. Each opening creates a new identity.
const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };
capture(value) { const receipt = Object.freeze({id: value.id, text: value.text}); receipts.push(receipt);for(const [token,fn]of [...listeners])if(listeners.has(token))fn(receipt);return receipt; },
